start.title: Very Wealthy
start.text:
You come back from Egypt to the Negev, and then to the hills between Bethel and Ai.
How wealthy are you now?

choices.text: Very wealthy — in livestock, silver and gold
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:2 — Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.

choices.text: Poor and empty-handed from the journey
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram came out of Egypt very wealthy.

choices.text: The same as before, with no change
choices.feedback: Genesis says Abram had grown very wealthy.

tension.title: The Land Cannot Support You
tension.text:
Both you and your nephew Lot have flocks, herds and tents.
What is the trouble?

choices.text: The land cannot support you both together, for your possessions are too great
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:6 — The land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great.

choices.text: You have too little livestock to feed anyone
choices.feedback: The trouble was too much livestock for the land, not too little.

choices.text: A great enemy is attacking both camps
choices.feedback: Genesis says the strain was from crowded flocks, not from war.

choices.text: Quarreling breaks out between your herdsmen and Lot's herdsmen
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:7 — And quarreling arose between Abram's herders and Lot's herders.

choices.text: Peace and joy spread through both camps
choices.feedback: Genesis says quarrels broke out between the herdsmen.

choices.text: Lot's herdsmen leave without a word
choices.feedback: Genesis says they quarreled, not that they simply left.

decision.title: You Speak to Lot
decision.text:
You want to end the strife.
What do you say to Lot?

choices.text: 'Let's not have any quarreling between you and me — we are close relatives'
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:8 — 'Let's not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.'

choices.text: 'You must leave at once — you are not my equal'
choices.feedback: Abram spoke kindly, appealing to their family bond.

choices.text: Say nothing and drive Lot out
choices.feedback: Genesis records Abram's peaceful words to Lot.

offering.title: First Choice
offering.text:
You offer Lot a choice.
What do you say?

choices.text: 'If you go to the left, I'll go to the right; if you go to the right, I'll go to the left'
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:9 — 'If you go to the left, I'll go to the right; if you go to the right, I'll go to the left.'

choices.text: 'I am the elder — I will choose first'
choices.feedback: Abram let Lot choose first, though he was the elder.

choices.text: 'We will both stay here and share every well'
choices.feedback: Abram proposed they part ways, so the strife would end.

lots_choice.title: Lot Looks Up
lots_choice.text:
Lot looks around at the land.
What does he choose?

choices.text: Lot chooses the whole plain of the Jordan, well watered like the garden of the Lord
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:10-11 — Lot looked up and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan was well watered, like the garden of the Lord; so Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan.

choices.text: Lot chooses the dry hill country
choices.feedback: Lot chose the well-watered plain of the Jordan.

choices.text: Lot refuses to choose and stays with Abram
choices.feedback: Genesis says Lot chose the Jordan plain and parted from Abram.

lot_departs.title: The Parting
lot_departs.text:
You and Lot part ways.
Where does Lot go?

choices.text: Lot sets out toward the east and pitches his tents near Sodom
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:11-12 — Lot set out toward the east; he pitched his tents near Sodom.

choices.text: Lot travels far west across the sea
choices.feedback: Lot went east, toward the plain and near Sodom.

choices.text: Lot goes back to Haran
choices.feedback: Lot went east toward the plain of the Jordan, near Sodom.

remaining.title: Where You Live
remaining.text:
Lot is gone.
Where do you live?

choices.text: Live in the land of Canaan
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:12 — Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain.

choices.text: Live in the plain of the Jordan near Sodom
choices.feedback: Lot lived near Sodom; Abram stayed in Canaan.

choices.text: Live in Egypt
choices.feedback: Abram had left Egypt; he lived now in Canaan.

the_promise.title: Lift Up Your Eyes
the_promise.text:
The Lord speaks to you after Lot has parted from you.
What does He say?

choices.text: 'Lift up your eyes; all the land you see I will give to you and your offspring forever'
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:14-15 — 'Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west. All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.'

choices.text: 'You will lose this land to Lot's descendants'
choices.feedback: The Lord promised the land to Abram's offspring forever.

choices.text: 'Return to Haran; the land is not yours'
choices.feedback: The Lord confirmed the gift of the land to Abram.

mamre.title: Walk Through the Land
mamre.text:
The Lord tells you what to do next.
What is it?

choices.text: 'Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you'
choices.feedback: Genesis 13:17 — 'Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you.'

choices.text: 'Stay in one place and never travel again'
choices.feedback: The Lord told Abram to walk through the land.

choices.text: 'Give the land back to the Canaanites'
choices.feedback: The Lord gave the land to Abram and his offspring.

altar.title: The Great Trees of Mamre
altar.text:
So you move your tents and go to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron,
where you build an altar to the Lord.
